title: Ing Exiled Covenant Breakers
intro: keng minunang panaun ning metung a bayung komunidad, ing metung a tribu menuknangan ya kareng kuta, a makagapus keng metung a kasunduan. Inyang ing kasunduan a ita me-traydor ya, ing bunga na niti mipalabas ya kareng bulung ning Quran. Ninu la reng taung deni, at nanu ing milyari kareng karelang pibale-bale at mula?
clues: Menuknangan kami kareng kuta na minie kekami keng e tutu a panamdam ning seguridad.
Tau kami ning Kasulatan, oneng linabag kami king kekaming kasunduan.
Migplanu kaming laban king tubud kaybat nang dinatang kekami, oneng mebigu ing kekaming planu.
Ding kekaming palma meputut la king utus ning Allah, tanda ning keyang upaya.
Pepalayas da kami kareng pibale-bale mi, e na kami mibalik, bilang parusa keng kekaming pamaglaban.
Ing Quran sasabyan na katamu keng chapter ning pamitipun, at ing kekatamung istorya magsilbi yang babala para kareng taung lalabag kareng kasunduan.

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
